services.name: CCTV Camera Installation
distinct_features: Mounting of up to 4 CCTV cameras (Dome/Bullet)
Routing and clipping of BNC/CAT6 cables up to 20 meters per camera
Connection to DVR/NVR and power supply
Mobile app installation and pairing on up to 2 devices

suggested_addons.text: Professional installation and configuration of IP or Analog CCTV cameras, including optimal placement for blind-spot coverage, secure wiring routing, DVR/NVR setup, and mobile app pairing for remote live viewing.

items: Optimal angle positioning to eliminate security blind spots
Concealed or neatly clipped wiring to maintain home aesthetics
DVR/NVR storage configuration for maximum video retention
Mobile application setup for real-time remote monitoring
Night vision and motion detection calibration
Supply of cameras, DVR/NVR, cables, or storage hard drives (labor only)
Concealed internal wall wiring requiring masonry/chasing
Setting up static IP configurations with ISP for older DVR models

steps.title: Site Assessment & Angle Planning
steps.description: Technician surveys the property to identify critical entry points and determine the optimal mounting locations and angles for maximum coverage.

steps.title: Camera Mounting & Wiring
steps.description: Cameras are securely drilled and mounted. Cables are routed from the cameras to the central DVR/NVR location using wire clips or PVC casing.

steps.title: System Connection & Power Up
steps.description: BNC/RJ45 connectors are crimped and connected to the cameras and the recording unit. Power supplies are securely connected and tested.

steps.title: DVR/NVR Configuration
steps.description: The hard drive is formatted, and recording parameters (resolution, frame rate, motion triggers) are configured in the DVR/NVR interface.

steps.title: Mobile App Pairing & Handover
steps.description: The security system is connected to the home router, and the manufacturer's app is installed and paired on the customer's phone for live viewing.

aftercare: Wipe camera lenses monthly with a microfiber cloth to ensure clear night vision
Regularly check the DVR/NVR storage to ensure older footage is overwriting correctly
Keep the DVR/NVR in a well-ventilated area to prevent hard drive overheating

tools: Impact drill machine and masonry drill bits
Cable crimping tools (RJ45/BNC) and wire strippers
Ladder, wire clips, rawl plugs, and mounting screws
Portable test monitor for angle adjustments

requirements: Ensure the cameras, DVR/NVR, hard drive, and cables are ready before the technician arrives
Provide access to a working power socket near the DVR/NVR location
Have your Wi-Fi password ready for network and mobile app configuration

items: All cameras firmly mounted with clear, unobstructed fields of view
Continuous or motion-triggered video reliably recording to the hard drive
Instant access to live camera feeds on the customer's smartphone
For heights exceeding 10 feet, the customer must arrange suitable scaffolding or safely secure long ladders
Drilling through heavily reinforced concrete beams may require specialized equipment not covered in standard installation

suggested_addons.details: 30-day SmartServe warranty on wiring integrity and camera mounting stability

items.answer: No, this is an installation-only service. You must purchase the cameras, DVR/NVR, hard drive, and cables separately.
items.question: Does this service include the cost of the CCTV cameras?

items.answer: Yes, if your TV is near the DVR/NVR, the technician will connect it via HDMI/VGA. If it is in another room, additional long-distance cabling is required.
items.question: Can the technician help me view the cameras on my TV?

items.answer: Standard through-wall drilling (up to 8 inches) is included. However, deep core cutting or concealed in-wall routing is excluded.
items.question: What happens if the cable needs to run through a thick wall?

items.answer: Most modern CCTV brands provide a free cloud P2P app for remote viewing. You only need an active internet connection at home.
items.question: Is the mobile app viewing free?

items: Enable push notifications on your mobile app only for motion in specific critical zones to avoid alert fatigue.
Install a small UPS for your DVR and router so cameras keep recording during power cuts.

dos: Mount cameras high enough to prevent easy tampering or vandalism
Use outdoor-rated (IP67) cameras for any exterior installations
donts: Don't point cameras directly at bright light sources (like streetlights) which can cause glare
Don't install the DVR/NVR in a locked, unventilated cabinet where it can overheat
